summary: Release 1.4.0, the next release after 1.3.0: Shared Drive bulk actions with progress, restore and permanent delete, PDF previews in an overlay with a card menu, the meeting preparation modal, Desktop log downloads with structured logging, and fixes around login, notifications and conversation creation. The published Helm chart pulls the image from quay.io/wire/wire-webapp; see the chart notes before upgrading.

changes.description: Shared Drive: bulk actions report their progress, bulk restore and permanent delete keep running when the view leaves the Bin, one bulk action at a time until its outcome settles (WPB-29990, WPB-30228, WPB-30322).
PDF files open in an overlay with the shared viewer, thumbnails and a card action menu; quoted PDF attachments stay compact (WPB-29908).
Meetings: preparation modal available across views, meeting type in the creation payload, reminder notification diagnostics.
Desktop: log downloads from the settings and structured logging when the Desktop app supports it; browser logging is composed at the build entrypoints.
Existing Shared Drives stay available during team offboarding; the team Cells status is set to DISABLED explicitly; pending onboarding status shown.
MLS: recovery of missing message references (WPB-23357), core-crypto 11, upgrade prompt when the browser lacks JSPI (WPB-30036).
Login shows a retryable error when local storage fails; duplicate conversation creation is prevented; in-app notifications stay visible after setting the status to away.

Video player crash in folders (WPB-30038), asset download of multipart message replies (WPB-30056), call timer reset, file size metadata normalized, double scrollbar on settings pages, message details and folders empty states.
Internal: native TypeScript 7 builds, camelCase file names, the legacy WebSocket lifecycle removed, gzip and deflate response compression.

The published Helm chart and image carry the application version: chart wire-webapp X.Y.Z on quay.io/wire/charts/stable, image quay.io/wire/wire-webapp:X.Y.Z. Set image.repository to keep another source.
